Bind Evidence Tables

Source: R/evidence_schema.R
bind_evidence.Rd

Combines several R4SUB evidence data.frames – for example the outputs of different adapters or indicators across the ecosystem – into one validated evidence table. Each input is validated against the evidence schema, the tables are row-bound, and colliding rows (more than one row sharing the same key) are detected and reported. The combined table carries a collision report in its evidence_collisions attribute, and duplicates can optionally be resolved.

Usage

bind_evidence(
  ...,
  keys = c("indicator_id", "asset_id", "location"),
  on_duplicate = c("keep", "first", "last", "error")
)

Arguments

...

Evidence data.frames to bind, or a single list of them.

keys

Character vector of columns forming the collision key, passed to evidence_collisions(). Defaults to c("indicator_id", "asset_id", "location").

on_duplicate

How to handle keys that appear on more than one row: "keep" (default) keeps all rows, "first" keeps the first row on each key, "last" keeps the last, and "error" aborts if any key collides.

Value

A single combined evidence data.frame with an evidence_collisions attribute holding the collision report (see evidence_collisions()).

Details

The default on_duplicate = "keep" preserves every row, so the combined table is exactly the row-bind of the inputs; the collision report is attached either way. Resolution, when requested, keeps the first or last row on each key, or aborts. This is purely structural: it never scores, weights, or decides which of two conflicting rows is correct.

See also

evidence_collisions().

Examples

ctx <- suppressMessages(r4sub_run_context("STUDY1", "DEV"))
make_ev <- function(ind_id) {
  suppressMessages(as_evidence(
    data.frame(
      asset_type = "validation", asset_id = "ADSL",
      source_name = "pinnacle21", indicator_id = ind_id,
      indicator_name = ind_id, indicator_domain = "quality",
      severity = "low", result = "pass",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    ctx = ctx
  ))
}
ev1 <- make_ev("IND-001")
ev2 <- make_ev("IND-002")
combined <- suppressMessages(bind_evidence(ev1, ev2))
nrow(combined)
#> [1] 2
attr(combined, "evidence_collisions")
#> [1] indicator_id asset_id     location     n            n_distinct  
#> [6] conflict     values      
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
